policies.identityProviders: provider products bind through protocol profiles; no generic provider switch
policies.clientMaterial: classified secret reference or assertion-service reference only; no secret value in shell, source, evidence, or logs
policies.authorization: named ASP.NET Core host policies and standard challenge/forbid only; roles, grants, principals, and domain policy meaning remain consumer-owned
policies.operationAttachment: every generated operation is explicitly anonymous or bound to one named host policy
policies.openApi: security schemes and operation attachments must match runtime declarations exactly
policies.tokens: JWT resource server accepts only signed, unexpired at+jwt access tokens with exact issuer, audience, and algorithm allow-list
